references.text: God's original instructions to Moses to make the mercy seat of pure gold with specific measurements. Exodus 37:6 describes the fulfillment of this command.
The mercy seat was to be placed on the ark of the covenant in the Most Holy Place, showing the central role of the mercy seat in the tabernacle.
The mercy seat is mentioned as the place where God will meet Moses, before the ark of the testimony.
The mercy seat is mentioned as part of the holy equipment that Bezalel was to make.
The mercy seat is mentioned in the list of items to be made for the tabernacle.
Moses placed the mercy seat on the ark when the tabernacle was set up.
The mercy seat is the place where God reveals Himself in the cloud, central to the Day of Atonement.
On the Day of Atonement, the high priest was to sprinkle blood on the mercy seat to make atonement for the people's sins.
God spoke to Moses from the mercy seat between the two cherubim.
The letter to the Hebrews refers to the cherubim overshadowing the mercy seat (ἱλαστήριον), linking this Old Testament image to Christ's atoning work.
Paul uses the term ἱλαστήριον (mercy seat/propitiation) for Christ, showing that He is the fulfillment of what the mercy seat symbolized.
The execution (37:6) was carried out exactly according to God's specific instruction (25:17), emphasizing the importance of obedience in holy service.
